sectionTitle: Explore a real site, right here.
sectionDescription: Everything below was captured by drone and processed with photogrammetry. The 3D model opens in any browser — click and drag to orbit. The comparison is two dated orthomosaics of the same site; drag the divider to see what changed.

captures.title: Stockpile Survey — with Ground Control Points
captures.description: Aggregate stockpile captured with GCPs for survey-tied accuracy. The same model supports cut/fill and volume calculations for pay applications.

captures.title: Chaney Blvd — Five Weeks of Construction Progress
captures.description: Same 17-acre site in Smyrna, March 1 vs April 7, 2026. Foundations poured, utilities trenched, pads graded. Every flight is dated and georeferenced, so a PM can show an owner exactly what was on site and when.
captures.beforeAlt: Orthomosaic of the Chaney Blvd site on March 1, 2026 — graded dirt with early excavation
captures.afterAlt: Orthomosaic of the Chaney Blvd site on April 7, 2026 — foundations, utility trenches, and equipment on site
